title: Aurelio Diaz
summary: A Division Agent in Broken Dawn whose investigation joins April Kelleher's Midwest antiviral trail, alongside agents Aurelio Diaz and Ike Ronson.

claims.text: Broken Dawn's published premise identifies Aurelio Diaz as one of the Division Agents traveling with April Kelleher's antiviral investigation.

Ubisoft's Broken Dawn overview names Aurelio Diaz on the team with April Kelleher and Ike Ronson, and the publisher entry has him following a trail that leads to April in the American Midwest; neither reviewed source places him at an Ann Arbor site or against a Mantis-directed operation.

paragraphs.text: Aurelio is one of Broken Dawn's named SHD Agents. The official premise places him beside April Kelleher as the inquiry moves out of the original game's New York setting.

UbiSoft's Broken Dawn overview names Aurelio Diaz on the team with April Kelleher and Ike Ronson, and the publisher entry has him following a trail that leads to April in the American Midwest. Neither reviewed source places him at a named research site or against any particular organization, so this record stops at the assignment itself.

verification.notes: Verified against reviewed Broken Dawn sources on 2026-10-12: the publisher catalogue entry is a marketing blurb and names only April Kelleher, Aurelio Diaz and Alex Irvine. Ubisoft's book overview names April Kelleher with Division agents Aurelio Diaz and Ike Ronson. Alani Kelso, the Mantis codename, Ann Arbor, Washington and the intelligence handoff appear in none of them, so those claims are downgraded to unknown and the dependent prose no longer asserts them. Breaking Dawn plot detail needs a readable copy or a detailed chapter summary before it can be restored.
